note: Registry of every external source used, with what it is authority for. Tier 1 is official and citable as a fact. Tier 2 is official but storefront-specific or login-gated. Tier 3 is non-official and is never cited as a fact.

tiers.1: Official primary source — citable as fact.
tiers.2: Official but conditional — storefront-specific, point-in-time, or login-gated. Must be labelled.
tiers.3: Not official — used only to discover tier-1 sources, never cited as fact.
